text:
miranda: intake — mosaic18b multi-quant bringup. saw quality drop under q4_0 and weird kv-cache mismatches on long seqs (>=2048). assigning triage.

kai: can you paste the minimal repro? what runtime (rust-engine v1.8.2?)

miranda: runtime: mainnet-build@2024-11-02 (rust-engine v1.8.2). repro: prompt with long context (~3.5k tokens) + streaming. failing both on dedicated and private. quick snippet:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://redwood/api/generate -d '{"model":"mosaic18b","quant":"q4_0","prompt":"<long-history>"}'
```

jamie: ran a small perf/quality sweep. fp16 baseline perplexity 12.8, q4_0 -> 15.9 on evaluation set A (same prompts). latency roughly +18% p50 under batch=1. logs show repeated `kv_mismatch` warnings in runtime.

sophia: I saw the kv eviction pointer drift when rotary scaling is enabled + 4-bit kernels. suspect RoPE index math interaction with blocked KV pages. reproducer attached (small dump) — sending offline.

alex: i'll take quant sweep (q4_0, q4_1, q5_0) and run with/without rotary scaling flags. ETA EOD. prefer to run on dedicated-qa (gpu-rt-8g).

miranda: prioritization suggestion: P0 = data corruption / kv mismatch (breaks decoding), P1 = perceptible quality regressions, P2 = perf regression. propose immediate rollback to fp16 variant for affected customers and limited canary for q4_0.

kai: add an eval checklist — unit prompts, long-range coherence, generation stability, sample diversity metrics. also need kernel trace from runtime: `RUNTIME_TRACE=kv,attn ./run_smoke.sh`.

deploy-bot: deploy event — canary rollout mosaic18b@canary started by miranda at 2024-11-03T09:42:17Z :rocket:

jamie: FYI I'm seeing the same kv warnings on emulated long-history tests. will attach small flamegraphs and a short runbook for the team.

miranda: thanks — alex + jamie pair on the sweep, kai owns eval harness and checklist, sophia digs into rotary math. update here with short notes. :thumbsup:
